title: Finaps is the clearest test case for the conversion thesis: ideal on every axis except that Mendix occupies the slot
content:
Finaps works in healthcare and the public sector at small scale, which the research describes as ideal on every axis but one: Mendix already occupies the slot a Powerhouse-based solution would take. Domain, size and client type all point the right way, and the incumbent platform is the single obstacle.

That combination is what makes it a test case rather than merely a good lead. Because everything else is favourable, the outcome isolates one question — whether a firm invested in a low-code platform will move work onto a document-model record layer. A refusal here is informative in a way that a refusal from a poorly matched lead is not, because there is no second explanation available.

The research calls that question the conversion thesis, and the whole Mendix cohort in this corpus is ranked against it. Finaps is where the thesis is cleanest to test, which is consistent with the cohort's recorded priority of 'decide thesis first': the sequencing matters, because the answer determines whether the cohort is worked at all.
